race.comment: FLYING ACE (2) gets the nod after being beaten just over a length at Balaklava after racing wide throughout, with the return to the mile a genuine positive. Can strike this time. FIORENTE RULES (5) looms as one of the dangers after switching back on with a Bordertown win, scoring by a length on soft ground and confirming her liking for this distance range, where she has two wins from four starts. The tougher meeting is the query. GOOCHEE GAL (6) has been holding her form, was sound at Gawler and had earlier placed in a Class 1 at Morphettville, with the 3kg claim helping her case. Each-way. ROYAL MUSE (8) resumed with a solid fifth in Class 2 grade at Murray Bridge, has won at this track and distance, and looks a serious danger if she builds on that first-up run.
